description:
In her younger days, Lee Hui-Jung was a well-known star actress. However, her life took a dramatic turn when her affair with 'Yeon Seon-Gu,' a popular film director and the husband of her close friend 'Kim Myeong-Hui,' was exposed. Subsequently, she faced a series of scandals following her friend's suicide and a traffic accident involving Yeon Seon-Gu.
As a result, Lee Hui-Jung left the entertainment industry, and 12 years passed. She received a tempting casting offer for a new film and, after much contemplation, decided to make her comeback in the film industry. But what she didn't expect was that the lead actress in the film would turn out to be 'Yeon Ji-Na,' the daughter of Kim Myeong-Hui and Yeon Seon-Gu...

(Source: Lezhin, translated)
